title: A Loop in the Hostel Log
story: The hostel log said the guest in bed four had signed out at ten, yet his grey coat still hung beneath the stairs. Amina remembered a quiet man who had asked about the early bus and carried no bag. His signature matched the line above it, including a strange loop the earlier guest, a courier, used on every parcel slip. Someone had copied that signature into the next space, so the book looked complete while a person remained unaccounted for. Amina did not raise an alarm in the corridor. She locked the front door, woke the manager, and checked the room. The bed was empty, the window latch was open, and a timetable on the blanket had the dawn departure circled. A forgotten coat could be explained. A copied signature could not be dismissed as a mistake. The tidy line had turned a departure into a record somebody wanted to look finished.
